Name: Cooking Skill (Unofficial 1.6 Update)
Author: JRZ247
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]This is an unofficial Stardew Valley 1.6 port of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/522]Cooking Skill[/url] by spacechase0.[/b] All credit for the original mod goes to spacechase0. This port was not made or endorsed by them, so please report problems with this version here, not to spacechase0.

The mod adds a new [b]Cooking[/b] skill to the skills page. It works like the vanilla skills: you level it up by cooking, your food gets better as you level, and you choose professions at levels 5 and 10.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip this mod into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game using SMAPI.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Earn cooking XP each time you cook a dish. Better food (more energy) gives more XP.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Each cooking level gives home-cooked food +3% energy and health.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Dishes can come out silver, gold or iridium quality. The chance depends on the quality of the ingredients you use: the more high-quality ingredients, the better the odds.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Six professions:[/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Level 5: Gourmet[/b] - +20% sell price[/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Level 10: Efficient[/b] - 15% chance to not consume ingredients[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Level 10: Professional Chef[/b] - home-cooked meals are always at least silver[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Level 5: Satisfying[/b] - +25% buff duration once eaten[/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Level 10: Intense Flavors[/b] - food buffs are one level stronger once eaten (+20% for max energy or magnetism)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Level 10: Secret Spices[/b] - a few random buffs when eating food with no buffs[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Changes from the original mod[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Fixes and changes added on top of the original Cooking Skill 1.4.5:[/color][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and SMAPI 4. The original no longer works in 1.6.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Works alongside vanilla cooking instead of replacing it.[/b] The original replaced the game's whole cooking-click code. This port lets the game cook as normal and only adjusts the result, so vanilla behaviour (quests, achievements, sounds, stacking dishes, gamepad) is kept, and it is more compatible with other mods.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Fixed: Qi Seasoning works again.[/b] The original's replacement cooking code skipped it. Seasoned dishes are now at least gold quality. If the skill already rolled gold or iridium for a dish, that quality is kept and the seasoning isn't used up.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Food-buff professions rewritten for 1.6's buff system.[/b] Satisfying and Intense Flavors now apply to every buff a dish gives (1.6 dishes can give more than one).[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]New: level-up feedback like the vanilla skills.[/b] Shows the "new ideas to sleep on" message when you level up during the day, and plays the level-up chime overnight. SpaceCore doesn't do either for custom skills.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]New: profession icons.[/b] Each profession now has its own icon on the level-up screen and when you hover over it on the skills page, made from the game's own sprites: money bag, Triple Shot Espresso, Wheat Flour, Chef Hat, Hot Pepper and Qi Seasoning. The original had none.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]New skills-page icon.[/b] The knife-and-fork icon was inconsistently larger than the vanilla skill icons. It's now a chef hat at the same size as the others.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] 1.28 or later[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]In multiplayer, each player who wants the Cooking skill needs the mod installed. Mods that cook without the vanilla cooking menu (custom cooking menus or automation) may not give cooking XP or apply the skill's effects.[/color][/size]

[list]

[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Pathoschild[/b], for maintaining the original's later updates, and for SMAPI.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The original mod's translators (German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Korean, Thai, Ukrainian and Chinese). Their translations are included.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]ConcernedApe[/b], for Stardew Valley. The new icons are made from the game's own sprites.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
